biotools.summary: RHRVEasy is an R package that automates heart rate variability (HRV) analysis, calculating up to 31 indices and performing statistical tests to identify differences between populations. The package streamlines a tedious process, especially for large studies, and was validated using datasets of healthy and congestive heart failure patients.
